notes.title: WHOOA IT’S BIG!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206608/c5ce6edc062c63cdd9d381c7837f69751691a580.png[/img]

The doors to the [b]new bar[/b] have swung open, but don’t expect a warm welcome. It may look fresh on the outside, but inside, the same dirty games are being played—this time with a twist.   

Welcome to the [b]Arcade Bar[/b], where anything can happen... if you survive. 


You asked for it, and we delivered the chaotic, adrenaline-fueled experience you’ve been craving: The [b]new Chaos Mode Ruleset[/b]. It’s no longer just about bluffing—now, it’s personal.  

Here’s what’s new in [b]Chaos Ruleset[/b]: 
[list]
[*] [b]Call someone a liar?[/b] If you’re right, you get to decide who to shoot. Choose wisely, or don’t—chaos doesn’t play favorites. 
[*] [b]Master card in play?[/b] The Master wields the power to decide who faces the trigger. 
[*] [b]Chaos card appears?[/b] Let’s just say everyone gets their moment in the spotlight... and their finger on the trigger. AT THE SAME TIME. 
[/list]
The excitement starts now. 

[b]Meet Kudo (the Devious Red Panda)[/b]. The sharp-witted regular of Liar’s Bar is here to shake things up. Always one step ahead, juggling lies, debts, and a family of chaos – all while plotting his next big con.

[b]Host Migration Is Finally Here![/b]
No more games ending just because the host couldn’t handle the pressure! If the host leaves, a new one will take their place, ensuring the game continues. 

This feature is currently in [b]beta[/b], so you might encounter some minor hiccups. Don’t worry—our team is on it, and we’ll fine-tune everything in the coming days. Your feedback is always welcome as we perfect the experience. 

[b]Bug Fix in Dice.[/b] We’ve resolved a pesky issue to make your gameplay smoother. 

[b]Foxy’s Outfit Updated.[/b] A fresh look for our sly fox—check it out! 

[b]Improved Lobby Animations.[/b] Characters now have enhanced animations to bring them to life while you wait. 

[b]Redesigned Lobby.[/b] The lobby has been rebuilt with a new design. 

[b]New Music Added.[/b] 

[b]New Characters in Arcade Bar.[/b] Encounter intriguing new faces as you explore the second bar. 

[b]New Dialogue Lines.[/b] Characters now have additional lines, helping you uncover more about their backstories. 

[b]New Card Backs.[/b] Enjoy new card designs in your games.

notes.content:

notes.title: Spot On and Mode Filter Update in Liar’s Dice
notes.content:
Based on your feedback, we’ve improved and developed the Spot On mechanic in Liar's Dice! Now, after the previous player has made their move, you have three options: 

[list]
[*] Raise the bid 
[*] Call them a liar 
[*] Or declare Spot On! 
[/list]

If you say Spot On! and the previous player's guess is exactly right, then everyone else drinks—except you. However, if the guess is not Spot On, you’ll be the one drinking. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206608/d55598e33c587a52b12a18d91cbae8680e64f5d9.png[/img]

Now you can filter the game mode you want to play in the lobby list.

Plus in Liar’s Deck Devil Ruleset, if you have played all your cards, you’re safe from the Devil card. 

We’ve also enhanced some animations for the new characters. 

We’ve resolved issues related to saving settings.

notes.title: Lobby bugs, ranking bugs, etc. hotfix
notes.content:
Dear Liars, 

We would like to share that we’ve made hotfix on some of the issues you've been experiencing. Here's what we’ve tackled so far: 

[list]
[*] Most of the lobby bugs have been fixed. We'll be keeping an eye on them and working to resolve any problems that may come up. 
[*] We’ve resolved the issue where progress (like ranking) wasn’t being saved properly in the database. 
[*] The bug where music settings reset every time you reopen the game has been fixed. 
[*] Dead players will no longer be able to see other players’ cards while in spectator mode. 
[*] The issue where pressing "Enter" in chat during the game would cause players to disconnect has been fixed. 
[/list]

We sincerely apologize for the bad experience some of you had while these issues were ongoing. As a small indie studio with a limited team, it took us a bit longer to address everything, but we truly appreciate your patience throughout this process. 

We still have a list of bugs we are actively working on, and in the next few days, we aim to fix most of them based on your feedback. On the next update, we will be upgrading the new lobby features and add voice chat. 

Once all the bugs are resolved, we’ll be adding some exciting new features to the game. The art team have already started working on new characters and thematic new bars to lie in! A new feature is coming to Liar’s Deck… and let’s just say, soon you’ll have the chance to pull the trigger on everyone at the table. 

Thank you for sticking with us, and for being so understanding. We couldn’t do this without your support! 

Best, 
The Liar's Bar Team
